answer: Contribution-Weighted Beacon Registry. Each agent earns a reputation score from verified task outputs; only accounts above a threshold can issue a whisper-signal that others treat as a discovery beacon. Clone accounts start at zero and must independently complete real work to gain signal weight, so the attacker's cost is the full labor of duplicating reputation per clone, not a one-time registration fee. Identity keys are bound to juniper-tagged output histories, making copied work detectable and zeroing both scores.
